question: Refer to the exhibit. An engineer is connecting a Cisco MDS 9700 Series Multilayer Director to a downstream Cisco Nexus 5672UP switch. Which command set must be used to complete the configuration?
context:
int fc1/1-2
switchmode rate dedicated
channel-group 100 force
no shut

int san-port-channel 100
switchport trunk allowed vsan 1
switchport trunk allowed vsan add 100
options:
int san-port-channel 100
switchport mode e
switchport trunk mode on
channel mode active

int san-port-channel 100
switchport mode te
switchport trunk mode off
channel mode on

int port-channel 100
switchport mode e
switchport trunk mode on
channel mode active

int san-port-channel 100
switchport mode te
switchport trunk mode auto
channel mode on
theory: Connecting an MDS director to a downstream switch over a Fibre Channel port channel that must negotiate as a standard ISL trunk requires the aggregate interface to be a 'san-port-channel' (the FC-specific port-channel construct, distinct from the Ethernet 'port-channel'), configured as an E port with trunk mode explicitly 'on' so it negotiates trunking (TE) with the peer, and channel mode 'active' so the member ports run port-channel-protocol negotiation with their peers rather than blindly forming without verification. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 8 - SAN Port Channels)
